lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li6Co8O16 (reduced formula Li3(CoO2)4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co and Li centers each surrounded by six oxygen neighbors, while O centers exhibit three- or fourfold geometric coordination involving Co, Li, and O. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 30 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between 6-vertex Co and Li polyhedra, as well as between 4-vertex O polyhedra.
